content.text:
The ribbon's group titles are bigger (12px, up from 10) and have more room: the shaded strip is 28px wide, up from 16. The vertical lines between groups are gone, so each group's title strip now marks where it starts. The gap between groups went up from 8px to 12px to make up for the lost lines. The thin lines between tabs' commands in the collapsed ribbon are unchanged, since they separate tabs, not groups.

I didn't see it on screen. My screenshots picked up your running release build and then another app that had focus, not the new build, so I stopped taking them.

**Tests:** the ribbon test now checks that the Appearance and Preferences groups have only the 12px gap between them. The suite shows 121 passed, 1 skipped (it needs the real harness), and the same palette test failing as before. The build has no warnings.

**Spec:** the groups section of `RibbonScope` now gives the 12px title, the padding either side of it on the strip, and no dividers. `piton check` and `piton build check` pass.

The code is in `src/ribbon.rs`, with the new check in `src/main_window.rs`.
